title: Uso del suelo (Overture Maps)
description: Polígonos de uso del suelo de Overture Maps dentro del partido de Pergamino, referenciados sin copiar los datos.

table:columns.name: id
table:columns.description: A feature ID. This may be an ID associated with the Global Entity Reference System (GERS) if—and-only-if the feature represents an entity that is part of GERS.

table:columns.name: geometry
table:columns.description: Classifications of the human use of a section of land. Translates `landuse` from OpenStreetMap tag from OpenStreetMap.

table:columns.name: sources
table:columns.type: STRUCT(property VARCHAR, dataset VARCHAR, license VARCHAR, record_id VARCHAR, update_time VARCHAR, confidence DOUBLE, "between" DOUBLE[], provider VARCHAR, "resource" VARCHAR, "version" VARCHAR)[]
table:columns.description: The array of source information for the properties of a given feature, with each entry being a source object which lists the property in JSON Pointer notation. All features must have a root level source which is the default source if a specific property's source is not specified.

table:columns.name: names
table:columns.type: STRUCT("primary" VARCHAR, common MAP(VARCHAR, VARCHAR), rules STRUCT(variant VARCHAR, "language" VARCHAR, perspectives STRUCT("mode" VARCHAR, countries VARCHAR[]), "value" VARCHAR, "between" DOUBLE[], side VARCHAR)[])
table:columns.description: Properties defining the names of a feature. The struct carries a primary name, optional common names by language, and optional rules. Quoted from the namesContainer definition in the Overture schema.

table:columns.name: level
table:columns.description: Z-order of the feature where 0 is visual level

table:columns.name: wikidata
table:columns.description: A wikidata ID if available, as found on https://www.wikidata.org/.

table:columns.name: source_tags
table:columns.description: Any attributes/tags from the original source data that should be passed through.

table:columns.name: class
table:columns.description: Further classification of the land use

table:columns.name: elevation
table:columns.description: Elevation above sea level (in meters) of the feature.

table:columns.name: surface
table:columns.description: Surface material, mostly from the OSM tag, with some normalization.

table:columns.name: version
table:columns.description: Version number of the feature, incremented in each Overture release where the geometry or attributes of this feature changed.

table:columns.name: bbox
table:columns.type: STRUCT(xmin DOUBLE, xmax DOUBLE, ymin DOUBLE, ymax DOUBLE)

data.title: GeoParquet, parte 00004 (externa)
data.description: Archivo de la publicación 2026-11-18.0 de Overture Maps. Cubre una región mayor que el partido; la expresión de procesamiento lee solo lo que cae dentro.

processing:expression.expression:
SELECT o.*
FROM read_parquet('https://overturemaps-us-west-2.s3.us-west-2.amazonaws.com/release/2026-11-18.0/theme=base/type=land_use/part-00004-2a6d9ee5-968a-54cc-a3cc-99c58e201248-c000.zstd.parquet', hive_partitioning = false) AS o,
     (SELECT geometry AS partido FROM read_parquet('https://data.source.coop/nlebovits/pergamino-ide/limites/partido_pergamino/partido_pergamino.parquet')) AS p
WHERE o.bbox.xmin <= -60.13879236 AND o.bbox.xmax >= -60.94404785 AND o.bbox.ymin <= -33.54021706 AND o.bbox.ymax >= -34.17655858
  AND ST_Intersects(o.geometry, p.partido)

visual.title: Teselas vectoriales de Overture (base)
visual.description: PMTiles que publica Overture Maps para todo el mundo. La capa de esta colección es `land_use`; el estilo por defecto oculta lo que cae fuera del partido.

recorte.title: Vistas DuckDB del recorte (vista `uso_del_suelo`)
recorte.description: Base DuckDB que contiene solo vistas, una por colección de este subcatálogo. Cada vista lee las partes externas con un prefiltro sobre la columna `bbox` y `ST_Intersects` contra el límite oficial del partido. Se abre con `ATTACH ... (READ_ONLY)` después de cargar `spatial` y `httpfs`.

style.title: Por defecto, con máscara del partido
style.description: Las capas del estilo por defecto de overture-portolan sobre las PMTiles de esta publicación, con una máscara que cubre todo lo que queda fuera del partido.

thumbnail.title: Vista previa
thumbnail.description: El recorte dibujado con el estilo por defecto sobre un mapa base, con la máscara aplicada.
